changeSet.author: Ivica Cardic
changeSet.comment: Add the nullable environment ordinal to workspace_user. NULL means every environment.

changeSet.author: Ivica Cardic
changeSet.comment: Remove duplicate (workspace_id, user_id) rows so uk_workspace_user_implicit can be created. Keeps the most privileged built-in role (0=ADMIN), ranks a custom-role row (NULL role) below every built-in one, and breaks ties by the lowest id.
changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM workspace_user wu USING workspace_user wu2 WHERE wu.workspace_id = wu2.workspace_id AND wu.user_id = wu2.user_id AND ( COALESCE(wu.workspace_role, 2147483647) > COALESCE(wu2.workspace_role, 2147483647) OR (COALESCE(wu.workspace_role, 2147483647) = COALESCE(wu2.workspace_role, 2147483647) AND wu.id > wu2.id) )

changeSet.author: Ivica Cardic
changeSet.comment: The H2 form of 20260819120001, with the same keep rule.
changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM workspace_user wu WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workspace_user wu2 WHERE wu2.workspace_id = wu.workspace_id AND wu2.user_id = wu.user_id AND ( COALESCE(wu.workspace_role, 2147483647) > COALESCE(wu2.workspace_role, 2147483647) OR (COALESCE(wu.workspace_role, 2147483647) = COALESCE(wu2.workspace_role, 2147483647) AND wu.id > wu2.id) ) )

changeSet.author: Ivica Cardic
changeSet.comment: At most one implicit row per member. Written as raw SQL because Liquibase's createIndex has no WHERE clause, and a plain three-column unique constraint would not do: PostgreSQL treats NULLs as distinct and would admit unlimited NULL rows for one member.
changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_workspace_user_implicit ON workspace_user (workspace_id, user_id) WHERE environment IS NULL;

changeSet.author: Ivica Cardic
changeSet.comment: At most one explicit row per member per environment.
changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_workspace_user_explicit ON workspace_user (workspace_id, user_id, environment) WHERE environment IS NOT NULL;

changeSet.author: Ivica Cardic
changeSet.comment: The H2 form of 20260819120002 and 20260819120003: one unique index covering the implicit row (environment -1) and each explicit row.

rollback.sql: DROP INDEX IF EXISTS uk_workspace_user_environment; ALTER TABLE workspace_user DROP COLUMN environment_key;
